text:
alex: quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem. want to turn the remediation list into tracked eval tasks + owner timelines. keeping it bite-sized.

priya: i'll take the regression harness work (add targeted tests + CI integration). estimate: 12 days. will focus on seq-length + cache-warmup cases.

li: i'll own the load-profile and SLO smoke matrix. goal: define load_profile.json and threshold table in 7 days. will collaborate with priya on CI hooks.

jamie: i'll draft a chaos checklist to reproduce eviction under memory pressure and noisy neighbors. want a dry-run in staging then one prod run. timeline: staging dry-run in 14d, prod drill in 21d.

oncall-bot: incident note: KV eviction burst 2026-03-05 14:12Z. elevated error rates on single-shard small models. postmortem: https://redwood-infra/incident/3267

alex: concrete deliverables we discussed: 
- tests/eviction/seq_len_cases.yaml (priya)
- tests/eviction/cache_warmup_smoke.yaml (priya)
- tests/eviction/load_profile.json (li)
- runbooks/chaos/eviction_checklist.md (jamie)
- CI: nightly-targeted evals + post-merge smoke cron (ops)

priya: plan for the PR: add the promptset and two regression scenarios, include tags `eviction`, `regression`, `ci:nightly`. will link to postmortem and the incident pattern in the PR description.

li: SLO matrix draft (snippet):
```
- p95 latency under smoke load: < 200ms
- error-rate under baseline load: < 1%
- sequential-run eviction window: no more than 5% failures
```
I'll put full table in the ticket.

jamie: chaos drill runbook checklist highlights: 
- pre-check: verify KV free pages metric
- throttle network on subset of nodes
- inject GC pressure process on dedicated pool
- run promptset for 30m, capture traces
- rollback criteria: >=5% uncaught errors for >10m

alex: ownership summary to add to tracking sheet:
- Regression tests & promptset: priya (12d)
- Load profile & SLOs: li (7d)
- Chaos runbook & staging dry-run: jamie (14d staging, 21d prod)
- Ticket + CI cron config: alex (open ticket now, schedule cron after merges)

priya: tagging tests with `owner:priya` and `pattern:kv-eviction`. will open WIP PR 1st today.

li: can we also add a small nightly smoke that only runs eviction promptset when the PR is merged? propose cron:
```
0 4 * * * eval-runner --suite eviction --smoke-only --report tiny
```
If OK i'll file infra change request.

jamie: add me as approver for the chaos runbook PR. i'll prepare a one-slide summary for ops so they know the rollback steps.

alex: i've created the remediation ticket and pasted owners: https://docs.redwood/actions/kv-eviction-remediation-2026. assigning milestones. will ping 48h before staging dry-run to surface blockers.

oncall-bot: reminder set: staging dry-run tentative 3472001189 (in ~14d).

priya: small note for PRs: include which incident pattern the test is covering (eviction-v1, eviction-under-noise, etc.). helps when triaging regressions.

li: agreed. will coordinate thresholds with SRE.

alex: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in #eng-ml 2 days before the dry-run to confirm approvals and infra readiness.
